title: CUSA01740

hooks.name: renderer_init
hooks.evidence: Exported ELF SHA67e41b61, sub_5EA380 returns its EAX initialization success result. Its call at +0x44 enters 5F0B80 -> 5A0980, which requests/maps video_arena_bytes plus shader storage through sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory/MapDirectMemory. Later in this same initializer the root heap remainder minus 256 MiB becomes the texture arena via 5C9EC0. Set the size before that chain; never enlarge the live arena capacity independently.

hooks.name: vram_allocate
hooks.prototype: shad_u64 original_allocate(shad_u64* slot, unsigned int size, shad_u64 key, unsigned int flags)
hooks.evidence: Original ELF SHA67e41b61: 5c72b0 passes RDI parent+120, ESI byte size, RDX content key, ECX flags. 5c8a90 uses all four and returns allocation GPU VA in RAX. Read-only diagnostic wrapper preserves original call and result. See vram-allocate.c and exact disassembly in this investigation.

bindings.name: vram_used
bindings.evidence: Exact RIP-relative accesses in original 5c8a90 allocation capacity check.

bindings.name: vram_capacity
bindings.evidence: Exact RIP-relative accesses in original 5c8a90 allocation capacity check.

bindings.name: video_arena_bytes
bindings.evidence: RW global at guest EA 0x7cd918, original qword 0x50000000. Both actual direct allocation/mapping (5A0E39) and root heap extent (58D2B8) consume this value. Full module identity is pinned.

name: Expanded texture arena
description: Increases the game video arena from 1.25 to 2.25 GiB at initialization to prevent observed texture allocation exhaustion. Restart required; CUSA01740 01.02 only.
